title: Mute autoplaying video
why: Browsers commonly block autoplaying video with audio, and unexpected playback can disrupt users and assistive technology.
suggestion: Add the muted attribute when autoplay is intentional, or remove autoplay and require an explicit user action.
limitations: The rule checks native video start tags in HTML, HTM, and Svelte files; videos created by scripts and uppercase Svelte components are not treated as native elements.
A present muted binding is accepted because its runtime value cannot be inferred statically.
